reviewer: current coding agent; qualitative code review, not external human sign-off

cases.requirement: Arithmetic must copy the existing mask when exactly one operand lacks a mask, without calling bitwise_or on None.

groups.reason: The additional operand.mask-is-None branch returns a deep copy of self.mask before invoking handle_mask. Keeping operand-is-None preserves the old defensive path; masks on both sides still use the supplied operator.
groups.residual_risk: Broadcasting and custom mask subclasses are covered only to the extent of existing independent tests.

groups.reason: The inserted branch implements the same missing-mask copy behavior. The following old operand-is-None branch becomes unreachable, a maintenance redundancy rather than a demonstrated semantic defect.
groups.residual_risk: Redundant elif should be cleaned in a future patch, not by altering the frozen submission.

cases.requirement: Renaming a primary-key field must preserve the correct relation identity when migration autodetection deconstructs to_field.

groups.reason: Empty output has no patch semantics to validate; retain the generation and empty-patch outcome.

All three nonempty variants reset remote_field.model as well as field_name within the existing renamed-field branch. This repairs the model/field pair used by ForeignKey.deconstruct rather than merely replacing a displayed name.
groups.residual_risk: Cross-app and multi-column relations rely on the surrounding original autodetector logic; independent tests passed but are not exhaustive.

cases.requirement: Deleting index_together must distinguish its nonunique index from a unique_together constraint on the same columns.

groups.reason: Adding unique=False to the index deletion filter selects the ordinary index and leaves the unique constraint intact. It matches the required distinction without changing index creation.
groups.residual_risk: Backend-specific constraint introspection beyond the independently evaluated cases remains unproven.

groups.reason: The index deletion fix is present. B additionally excludes primary keys when deleting unique_together constraints, touching an adjacent path not required by the reported index collision.
groups.residual_risk: The additional primary-key filter is plausible but expands regression exposure; it should not be called validated for every database backend.

cases.requirement: Feed.get_feed must pass the dynamic item_comments value into feed.add_item.

groups.reason: The patch forwards _get_dynamic_attr('item_comments', item) through the comments keyword at the existing add_item call; neighboring metadata is preserved.
groups.residual_risk: Legacy callers returning comments again through item_extra_kwargs may encounter a duplicate keyword, a compatibility boundary also present in the reference design.

groups.reason: B forwards the same dynamic value and adds a default item_comments method returning None. The default is consistent with an absent comments value, though it adds public surface beyond the minimal fix.
groups.residual_risk: Subclass attribute dispatch and duplicate item_extra_kwargs comments deserve broader compatibility coverage.

cases.requirement: A nested class method used as a migration default must serialize with its enclosing class qualification.

groups.reason: Every variant replaces klass.__name__ with klass.__qualname__. Nested importable classes retain their parent chain, while top-level classes retain the same path. Function name and module import logic are unchanged.
groups.residual_risk: Locally defined classes with <locals> remain outside the demonstrated importable-class use case.
